segments.t: After her meeting with Arkady, Marina meets Osipenko to pass along the lead. Arkady claimed his hidden millions are tucked away in a local kindergarten called The Golden Key. Osipenko immediately suspects a trap, but prepares to verify it anyway. Listen to their Russian conversation first, and do not worry about catching every word.
Он назвал место, где лежат деньги.
Мне кажется, как-то всё очень просто.
Мы всё равно проверим этот детский сад.
Let's examine line by line how Osipenko evaluates the report from Marina.
'Is contact made?' An informal expression meaning successful contact was established.
'What did he say?' Osipenko demands the exact words from the cafe.
Он назвал место, где лежат деньги.
'He named the place where the money lies.' The verb of location takes the plural subject.
'And where are these millions?' The emphatic particle adds impatience to the question.
'In the Golden Key kindergarten.' The prepositional case indicates physical location.
Мне кажется, как-то всё очень просто.
'It seems to me, somehow everything is very simple.' The impersonal construction expresses doubt.
'And could he have lied?' The negative particle softens the speculative question.
'He lied, of course!' Osipenko assumes Arkady is always plotting deceit.
'So what is good about that then?' The genitive singular of the adjective follows what.
'It was a test.' The past tense feminine noun refers to a probe or trial.
'You think he is testing us?' The imperfective verb denotes an ongoing suspicion.
Мы всё равно проверим этот детский сад.
'We will check that kindergarten all the same.' The fixed idiom means regardless.
'Be careful, he is very cunning.' The imperative plural expresses an urgent warning. Now listen to the interrogation of the information once again.
Он назвал место, где лежат деньги.
Мне кажется, как-то всё очень просто.
Мы всё равно проверим этот детский сад.
Osipenko figures that whether it is a real hiding spot or a clever trap, the kindergarten must be secured immediately. In the next scene, Arkady calls his ally Zavarzin.
